evidence: CoCl2(TMEDA) (TMEDA = N,N,N’,N’-tetramethylethylenediamine) precursor was synthesized in house using a simple one-step room temperature route giving 99% yield. The precursor was heated to 170 °C in an open boat held inside the ALD reactor and pulsed by inert gas valving. Nitrogen (N2, 99.999%, AGA) was further purified using a SAES Microtorr MC1-902F purifier and was used as the carrier and purge gas at a flow rate of 400 sccm.
